output.summary: A genus of shrubs and small trees occurring in temperate and subtropical regions worldwide, with high diversity in southern Africa. Their reddish fruits form dense clusters; poison sumac belongs to Toxicodendron and instead bears white drupes. Dried fruits of some Rhus species are ground as a tangy spice or steeped in water for drinks.
output.edibilityNote: Fruits of some species are ground as a tangy spice or steeped for drinks; R. coriaria is the principal culinary species.
